note: The three endings of docs/STORY.md, chosen by ANHMissions::Ending from the flags and Integrity when mission 12 is over.
credits: Everybody and everything in this story is fictional.
Lagos goes on. So does the hustle.

broadcast.title: The Broadcast
broadcast.speaker: Oshoja Park, a month on
lines: The ledger went out live. Every naira, from the Oshoja levy to the Kingmaker's campaign.
The Kingmaker withdrew by morning. Big Bar's accounts are frozen. Shina Garage is in a cell.
There is no levy at Oshoja Park any more.
Iya Tobi owns Femi's danfo again. Tunde and Amaka run it together.

bigmans_boy.title: The Big Man's Boy
bigmans_boy.speaker: Oshoja, a month on
lines: Tunde rides at the back of Big Bar's convoy now. Rich. Untouchable.
Amaka left the week after. She did not say where.
The convoy sweeps past Oshoja Park without slowing.
A new boy collects the levy there. He collects it for Tunde.

gone_quiet.title: Gone Quiet
gone_quiet.speaker: Stilt Town Waters, a month on
lines: Tunde and Amaka took the Crestline money and went quiet on the water.
Somebody at Oshoja Park still pays the levy.
Some nights Tunde takes the boat out and looks back at the lights.
